core_obligations: (1) implies (2): a locally quasi-finite morphism is quasi-DM, and any locally quasi-finite morphism of algebraic spaces over a base change of the source stays locally quasi-finite over the base algebraic space (proof lines 5156-5170)

(2) implies (3): choosing a flat locally finitely presented cover of the source over a test algebraic space, condition (2) applied to that cover exhibits the required locally quasi-finite cover (proof lines 5171-5185)
(3) implies (4): the cover of (4) is a special case of (3) after choosing the test object (proof lines 5186-5196)

(4) implies (1): test the property along the flat locally finitely presented cover given in (4) and use the composition permanence to get local quasi-finiteness of the morphism itself (proof lines 5197-5214)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：局部拟有限 ⇒ quasi-DM；且代数空间上局部拟有限的态射在基扩张后仍局部拟有限。
(2)⇒(3)：取满平坦局部有限表现的 U → X ×_Y V，由 (2) 得 U → V 局部拟有限。
(3)⇒(4)：取 V → Y 即得所需覆盖。
(4)⇒(1)：沿 (4) 给的覆盖检验局部拟有限性，再用复合保持性。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives four equivalent conditions for a morphism of algebraic stacks to be locally quasi-finite: local quasi-finiteness itself, quasi-DM-ness together with a test over algebraic spaces, the existence of locally quasi-finite flat finitely presented covers over every test object, and one such cover over a single flat finitely presented cover of the target (author lemma at source lines 5134-5154, label lemma-characterize-locally-quasi-finite). The proof (source lines 5156-5215) runs the four implications, using the quasi-DM characterization in the first, the covering criterion in the second and fourth, and composition permanence at the end (proof lines 5156-5214). The construction of the covers and the closing permanence step are the substance. H3.
